en.headline: Chief Executive says Hong Kong is ideal launchpad for mainland firms going global
en.dek: John Lee told the Global Unicorn Summit that the city has nurtured around 20 local unicorns and offers comprehensive support through Science Park and Cyberport for startups expanding internationally.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Monday that Hong Kong is the ideal springboard for mainland unicorn companies and technological startups seeking to expand overseas.

Speaking at the opening of the Global Unicorn Summit at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai, Lee noted that the city has nurtured around 20 local unicorn companies over the past decade, demonstrating its capacity to foster world-class innovative enterprises.

He said Hong Kong Science Park and Cyberport provide startups at various stages with incubation programmes, matching funds, marketing support, expansion opportunities and infrastructure. Lee added that Hong Kong is also a premier hub for overseas tech and innovation enterprises looking to expand into the mainland market.

zh.headline: 行政長官：香港是內地企業「走出去」的理想跳板
zh.dek: 李家超在全球獨角獸峰會表示，過去十年本港孕育約20家本地獨角獸企業，科學園及數碼港為初創提供全面支援。
body: 行政長官李家超周一表示，香港是內地獨角獸企業及科技初創拓展海外市場的理想跳板。
他在灣仔會展舉行的全球獨角獸峰會開幕禮上指出，過去十年本港已孕育約20家本地獨角獸企業，顯示香港有能力培育世界級創新企業。
李家超表示，香港科學園及數碼港為不同發展階段的初創提供孵化計劃、配對基金、市場推廣、拓展機會及基礎設施等全面支援。他亦指香港是海外科技及創新企業進軍內地市場的首選樞紐。
